mapper.sql: id, contest_id, vp_attempt_id, problem_id, user_id, language, score, status, run_time, run_memory, error_message, create_time
id, contest_id, vp_attempt_id, problem_id, user_id, language, score, status, run_time, run_memory, create_time
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM submission WHERE contest_id = #{contestId} AND vp_attempt_id IS NULL ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC

SELECT t.id AS tagId, t.name AS tagName, t.parent_id AS parentId, t.dimension AS dimension, COUNT(DISTINCT s.problem_id) AS attempted, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 1 THEN s.problem_id END) AS passed, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM submission s2 WHERE s2.user_id = s.user_id AND s2.problem_id = s.problem_id AND s2.create_time < s.create_time) = 0 THEN s.problem_id END) AS firstTryPassed, COUNT(s.id) AS totalSubmissions, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN s.status = 1 THEN s.run_time END), 0) AS avgAcTimeMs, COALESCE(MAX(p.difficulty), 0) AS maxDifficulty FROM submission s JOIN problem_tag pt ON pt.problem_id = s.problem_id JOIN tag t ON t.id = pt.tag_id JOIN problem p ON p.id = s.problem_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.create_time >= #{from} AND s.create_time < #{to} GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.parent_id, t.dimension

SELECT t.dimension AS dimension, COUNT(DISTINCT s.problem_id) AS attempted, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 1 THEN s.problem_id END) AS passed, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM submission s2 WHERE s2.user_id = s.user_id AND s2.problem_id = s.problem_id AND s2.create_time < s.create_time) = 0 THEN s.problem_id END) AS firstTryPassed, COUNT(s.id) AS totalSubmissions FROM submission s JOIN problem_tag pt ON pt.problem_id = s.problem_id JOIN tag t ON t.id = pt.tag_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.create_time >= #{from} AND s.create_time < #{to} AND t.parent_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.dimension
SELECT DISTINCT problem_id FROM submission WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalSubmissions, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS acceptedSubmissions, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 1 THEN s.problem_id END) AS solvedProblemCount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.problem_id) AS attemptedProblemCount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1), 0) AS acRate, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(s.create_time AS DATE)) AS activeDays FROM () s

SELECT t.id AS tagId, t.name AS tagName, t.parent_id AS parentId, t.dimension AS dimension, COUNT(DISTINCT s.problem_id) AS attempted, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 1 THEN s.problem_id END) AS passed, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.rn = 1 AND s.status = 1 THEN s.problem_id END) AS firstTryPassed, COUNT(s.id) AS totalSubmissions, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN s.status = 1 THEN s.run_time END), 0) AS avgAcTimeMs, COALESCE(MAX(s.difficulty), 0) AS maxDifficulty FROM () s INNER JOIN problem_tag pt ON pt.problem_id = s.problem_id INNER JOIN tag t ON t.id = pt.tag_id GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.parent_id, t.dimension

SELECT t.dimension AS dimension, COUNT(DISTINCT s.problem_id) AS attempted, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 1 THEN s.problem_id END) AS passed, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.rn = 1 AND s.status = 1 THEN s.problem_id END) AS firstTryPassed, COUNT(s.id) AS totalSubmissions FROM () s INNER JOIN problem_tag pt ON pt.problem_id = s.problem_id INNER JOIN tag t ON t.id = pt.tag_id WHERE t.parent_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.dimension

SELECT GREATEST(800, LEAST(3000, FLOOR(s.difficulty / 100) * 100)) AS rating, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 1 THEN s.problem_id END) AS solved, COUNT(DISTINCT s.problem_id) AS attempted FROM () s GROUP BY GREATEST(800, LEAST(3000, FLOOR(s.difficulty / 100) * 100))
SELECT s.problem_id AS problemId, MIN(s.create_time) AS occurredAt FROM () s WHERE s.status = 1 GROUP BY s.problem_id ORDER BY MIN(s.create_time) DESC, s.problem_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.problem_id AS problemId, MAX(s.create_time) AS occurredAt FROM () s GROUP BY s.problem_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 ORDER BY MAX(s.create_time) DESC, s.problem_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.problem_id AS problemId, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.title, ''), CONCAT('题目 #', s.problem_id)) AS problemTitle, COUNT(*) AS submitCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS acCount FROM submission s INNER JOIN class_student cs ON cs.student_id = s.user_id AND cs.class_id = #{classId} LEFT JOIN problem p ON p.id = s.problem_id WHERE s.create_time >= #{from} AND s.create_time < #{to} GROUP BY s.problem_id, p.title ORDER BY submitCount DESC

SELECT s.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(cs.remark, ''), NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) AS studentName, COUNT(*) AS submitCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS acCount, MAX(s.create_time) AS lastSubmitTime FROM submission s INNER JOIN class_student cs ON cs.student_id = s.user_id AND cs.class_id = #{classId} LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.create_time >= #{from} AND s.create_time < #{to} GROUP BY s.user_id, u.nickname, u.username, cs.remark ORDER BY submitCount DESC
